text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

I'm sorry for any inconvenience, but we don't offer phone support. There are a few other easy ways to get help, though:

- **Chat:** 8am-8pm, Monday to Saturday (your local time)
- **Email:** help@leafy.example, answered within 1 business day
- **Plant Care Specialists (chat):** 9am-5pm, Monday to Friday (your local time), for free care advice on any plant question

I'm happy to help with whatever's going on right now. If you tell me a bit more, I'll do my best to sort it out or point you to the right next step.

Hope to help you soon, and happy planting! 🪴
